title: 11 — ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA, DEFINITION OF READY, DEFINITION OF DONE
summary: Defines global Definition of Ready/Done templates and objective verification criteria for deliverables DL-1..10 and milestone acceptance.
notes: Acceptance-criteria doc with verifiable thresholds, artifact paths, and gate tables — process/verification contracts the system must honor → SPEC over PRD. No user stories, no decision/consequences sections. PRD signal present (acceptance criteria) but content is objective verification contracts, not product requirements.
